subject.title: feat(site): Switchboard keycap redesign for the product site (before/after)

question: Should the product site adopt the Switchboard visual identity, and should that direction be reviewed or landed together with https://github.com/openclaw/clickclack/pull/56?
rationale: Tests can verify rendering and build consistency, but they cannot determine whether replacing the current warm brand language is the intended product direction.

options.title: Coordinate both redesigns
options.body: Approve the shared Switchboard direction and review the product-site and app PRs as a coordinated brand change after their branch-specific blockers are fixed.

options.title: Approve site independently
options.body: Accept the product-site redesign on its own while allowing the app redesign to follow a separate review and landing schedule.

options.title: Retain current identity
options.body: Decline the Switchboard direction and keep the existing warm product-site visual system.

recommendation.title: Coordinate both redesigns
recommendation.body: Approve the shared Switchboard direction and review the product-site and app PRs as a coordinated brand change after their branch-specific blockers are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: Shakker introduced the current product-site component and stylesheet, making them the strongest history-based routing candidate for this design decision.
